firm_data.firm_description: Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg, LLP is a nationally recognized law firm providing comprehensive defense litigation and insurance coverage services. They represent professionals, businesses, financial institutions, and insurance companies.
notable_facts: Represents many leading insurance companies and financial institutions

email.subject: AI for Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Margaret,

Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg has built something rare: a 62-attorney firm that handles complex defense litigation across Professional Liability, Labor and Employment, and D&O work without the overhead of BigLaw. That operational efficiency is exactly what we're helping firms like yours scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for defense firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-sized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding in the New York market. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
